claims.text: Many reviewers say these wipes were recommended by their eye doctor or ophthalmologist and use them for dry eyes, blepharitis, or infection tendencies.
Reviewers commonly report that the wipes gently and effectively clean eyelids, lashes, and eye area, leaving eyes feeling refreshed and helping control dryness and irritation.

Several reviewers praise the convenience and value of the multi-pack or individually wrapped pads, though one reviewer warns that the listing misleadingly contains only one box of 30 pads rather than three.
A few reviewers mention using the wipes to remove makeup or as a general facial cleanser.
One reviewer reports a negative reaction, claiming the wipes caused their eyelids to wrinkle and look bad, which resolved after stopping use.
